issues.title: Plan 001: Completar MidEast: rodear los coches, reacoplar y terminar el servicio

criteria.criterion: Completar Firsby–Spilsby con 84030 y dos Mk1 originales.
criteria.result: Original live-drive report: all four native PAT legs, 84030 and both original Mk1, six original stops and ACT successful.

criteria.criterion: Rodear los coches sin trasladarlos entre vías y conservar frenos, ocupación y posición.
criteria.result: The two parked Mk1 keep exact track positions throughout the 50 ms run-around loop; front pickup projects 1.1819206 mm against a 1 cm predeclared gate. Brakes, native occupancy and steam inventories survive both restores.

criteria.criterion: Documentar una prueba manual desde el menú y un caso de aceptación reproducible; comprobar persistencia y errores relevantes para este alcance.
criteria.result: Menu/manual guide, repeatable CPU driver and two real save/restore checkpoints. Directed reversal clearance regression preserves a pending reversal until the whole locomotive clears the points.

issues.title: Plan 005: Gestionar varias secciones propias desacopladas simultáneamente

criteria.criterion: Conservar identidad, vía, frenos y ocupación de cada sección.
criteria.result: Persistent vehicle/section IDs, independent physical paths and occupied edges; per-vehicle brakes, bearings, axles, bogies and freight remain attached to identity.

criteria.criterion: Desacoplar y recoger dos o más secciones en distinto orden con guardado intermedio.
criteria.result: Two cuts are picked recent-first and oldest-first; front pickup permutes the complete immutable/mutable hardware and restores without losing a section.

criteria.criterion: Añadir ensayos representativos de fuerzas/estados y una prueba de conducción; usar oráculos OR 1.6.1 para lo equivalente y pruebas propias para extensiones.
criteria.result: Thirty-second integrated drive after actual pipe release and restore; native force/profile/impulse fixtures from OR 1.6.1 remain unchanged, with new Rust portion invariants tested separately. MidEast supplies an additional original-content physical run-around.

issues.title: Plan 006: Dividir y unir servicios de horarios con formaciones ajenas

criteria.criterion: Resolver identidades de servicios y porciones ajenas.
criteria.result: Original service names and permanent per-source vehicle identities survive front/rear collection, return and changes of the receiving driver. Same-table native pickup/forms resolve canonical identities.

criteria.criterion: Unir o dividir servicios conservando vehículos, reservas, horario y estado de frenos.
criteria.result: Join unions physical reservations, while return partitions authority by actual footprint. Original schedules, departure clocks, hose/cock pressure and service-specific objectives are conserved.

criteria.criterion: Documentar una prueba manual desde el menú y un caso de aceptación reproducible; comprobar persistencia y errores relevantes para este alcance.
criteria.result: Two menu examples plus manual instructions; snapshot history replays chronological receivers and rejects invalid, distant, future or moving operations without state loss.

source_hash_scope: Current source hashes are receipt metadata after root formatting. The original driving preflight inside acceptance.json records the actual tested binary/source hashes unchanged. Final formatted-workspace validation is recorded separately.

directed_result.viewer_ECS: pass: both real Bevy ECS portion identity/reparenting tests in the unified gate

limits: Native timetable import supports same-table $pickup and returning the entire previously joined foreign portion with signed $detach/units/forms. Full $attach, pools, newly created arbitrary formed services, and cross-table references remain explicit diagnostics.
Only a complete foreign portion at a physical end can be returned; removing a middle portion without rearranging track is rejected.
The runtime contact API retains its existing 1 m bound. The 1 cm gate applies to the measured MidEast acceptance drive.

This CPU acceptance verifies operational state and source identities. It does not claim a manual visual/audio session was performed, full steam physics parity, or adherence to the original arrival times.
A C# TCS host cannot be cloned by portion transactions; normal Rust TCS is used.

final_integration.source_hash_scope: The historical MidEast drive and directed-test receipts remain unchanged. This later unified gate validates the final formatted sources separately.
